At native and enlarged views each figure has one head, two arms, two hands, two legs and two feet; visible hands show five digits and each of four bare feet shows five toes. rows.scene: Even the highest celestial realm is unsettled; the poet seeks refuge and release.
rows.candidate_status: Brahma has four distinct heads (three faces visible and one rear-facing head) and four attached arms holding the lotus, rosary, water pot and blank palm-leaf scripture. His crowns are plain matte ochre with no jeweled bands or gemstones; chest, arm and wrist decoration is reduced to a thin necklace with small pendant and minimal plain bands, with sacred thread retained. His central expression remains dignified and uneasy. Bhattathiri's cheek center (697,480) skin-only 11x11 median is RGB (167,89,48), R-B 119; torso center (651,616) is (206,133,98), R-B 108; upper-arm center (615,650) is (185,97,53), R-B 132, a disclosed guide deviation. Fresh producer review is recorded; independent exact-checksum review pending; art remains unapproved.
